detached_structure.evidence: A small light-colored structure or shed is visible to the east of the main house near the trees, and a vehicle-like object sits to the west. It is partly obscured and not clearly a building.

signals.notes: The central house has a dark gray multi-gable roof. The yard is cluttered with debris and items on the west side, and heavy tree canopy covers the east side. A white pickup-like vehicle and a white car are parked near the driveway at the top.
